Title: As a sales director, I want revenue by region, so that I can see which regions are underperforming without asking the data team
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard shows total revenue per region for the selected month

Title: As a sales director, I want revenue by product category, so that I can see which products drive revenue
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard shows total revenue per product category for the selected month

Title: As a sales director, I want the dashboard to refresh automatically, so that I never see stale numbers
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard reflects the prior day's closed sales by 7 AM each morning, with no manual steps
